status.someMissing: {loaded} of {count} images loaded, {missing} could not be loaded

missingAlert: {missing} of {count} images could not be loaded. Each one says so when you reach it. {context, select, task {Reload the page to retry.} other {Close the viewer and open the series again to retry.}}

help.mouse: Mouse. Wheel changes image, drag sets the window, Shift-drag moves, right-drag zooms.
help.keyboard: Keyboard, with the image focused. Arrows change image (Page Up and Page Down by ten, Home and End for the ends), Shift-arrows move, + and − zoom, I inverts, R resets.

failure.emptyDetail: This series has no image you can open.
failure.decoderTitle: The viewer cannot decode this series
failure.decoderDetail: Image {position} is stored as {syntax}, a compression this viewer has no decoder for. {context, select, task {Skip this task and tell the campaign manager.} other {Download the files to open them in another viewer.}}
failure.refusedTitle: The viewer cannot show this series faithfully
failure.refusedDetail: Image {position} is stored as {syntax}, a compression this viewer decodes with errors in the grey levels. {context, select, task {Skip this task and tell the campaign manager.} other {Download the files to open them in another viewer.}}
failure.openTitle: The series could not be opened
failure.openAddress: Storage refused the file. It may no longer be available to you; reload the page and try again.
failure.openNetwork: The first image could not be fetched from storage. Check your connection and try again.
failure.changedDetail: Its files are no longer the ones that were being shown. {context, select, task {Reload the page.} other {Close the viewer and open the series again.}}
failure.startDetail: The series could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again; if it keeps failing, {context, select, task {skip this task and tell the campaign manager.} other {download the files instead.}}
